description: This is a PHP unit test file for the QuickLaunchDao class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests various methods that retrieve quick launch items based on different configurations and fixture data.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for QuickLaunchDao, testing retrieval of quick launch items based on configuration fixtures.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the QuickLaunchDao instance and sets up the test fixture directory. Prepares the kernel with mock services before each test.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the quick launch list with modules enabled and periods defined, expecting a specific set of items.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the quick launch list for ESS with modules enabled and periods defined.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList2
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the quick launch list with modules enabled but periods undefined, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS2
methods.description: Tests retrieval for ESS with modules enabled and periods undefined, expecting empty list.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList3
methods.description: Tests retrieval when the leave module is disabled, expecting a specific subset of items.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS3
methods.description: Tests retrieval for ESS when the leave module is disabled, expecting a subset of items.
